_doc: Ground colours for panels (style bible §3). A panel's "ground" is one of these names, or a hex. A panel's "sky" (above the horizon) takes the same names. A colour is a hex; [top, bottom], a vertical gradient (night); or { "horizontal": [left, right] } (sky-blue). Every ground carries a gradient, the direction picked arbitrarily (2026-11-11), to be reviewed; the first colour is the original flat one. Artist's rule (2026-11-08): backgrounds are light — off-white (light beige), light-grey, even white; greens only for top views (03.01) and the land strip under a sky/horizon (05.12); dusty-pink never. 2026-11-15: sage and forest dropped (too close to dry-grass and dark-green), green added (a brighter green). night-blue: a more saturated night (chapter 10).
